title: IPU documents released to Tim Cooper
summary: UAPGerb tells of IPU documents released to Tim Cooper, about 1994-1995 at an unknown place, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: interplanetary phenomenon unit documents that were I think released in 1994 1995 to Tim Cooper from uh a pseudonym Thomas Kwell

plain: A UFO researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, describes a set of papers called the Interplanetary Phenomenon Unit documents, said to come from a secret military unit studying UFOs. He says he thinks they were released in 1994 or 1995 to a researcher named Tim Cooper by someone using the false name Thomas Kwell. If real, they would show an official UFO unit existed decades ago.
